description: This file defines the TimeConfigPeriodModel class which is part of the OrangeHRM Time API module. It implements serialization logic for the TimeConfigPeriod data transfer object, exposing a 'startDay' property for API responses.

classes.name: TimeConfigPeriodModel
classes.description: A model class representing time configuration period data for API serialization, encapsulating a TimeConfigPeriod object.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a TimeConfigPeriod object.

methods.name: getTimeConfigPeriod
methods.description: Getter method to access the encapsulated TimeConfigPeriod object.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the model data into an associative array with 'startDay' property.
